# Ten flagship projects (generated by `scripts/build_status.py`)

Chosen for breadth (RAG, agents, data engineering, MLOps, security, cloud-as-code) and for the strength of their evidence, not for size. Each runs locally with `make -C pocs/<dir> demo` (the demo writes `results/`, which the README embeds) and `make -C pocs/<dir> test`.

| # | POC | fidelity | why it is a flagship | test functions | labels | needs |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | [NL-to-SQL over a semantic layer with query validation and guardrails](../pocs/003-text-to-sql-semantic-layer) | full | Governed natural-language-to-SQL with a semantic layer: the broadest guard test-suite in the portfolio (131 parametrised test cases). | 26 | tested, unverified | CI: fast (py3.12 + py3.13) |
| 98 | [Reference architecture: governed enterprise RAG platform](../pocs/098-reference-enterprise-rag) | full | Reference enterprise RAG that composes earlier POCs (citations, PII, audit log, erasure) with 14 end-to-end scenarios. | 15 | tested | CI: fast (py3.12 + py3.13) |
| 35 | [Bronze/silver/gold lakehouse: incremental, idempotent, SCD2, contract-gated](../pocs/035-medallion-lakehouse-duckdb) | full | Medallion lakehouse on DuckDB with SCD2, quarantine of known injected defects, replay-safety and a data-contract gate. | 18 | tested, unverified | CI: fast (py3.12 + py3.13) |
| 39 | [Postgres logical-decoding CDC to a Parquet lake: snapshot plus stream, atomic transactions, crash-safe replay (real Postgres 16; Debezium and Kafka not used)](../pocs/039-postgres-logical-cdc-to-lake) | local-variant | Change data capture from a real PostgreSQL 16 logical replication slot into a Parquet lake: snapshot/stream handoff, atomic transactions, crash-safe replay. | 19 | tested, unverified | CI: heavy workflow (path-filtered) |
| 97 | [Reference AI data platform: lakehouse, contract gate, incremental vector index, model gate and tracing wired end to end (file-batch source; no Debezium)](../pocs/097-reference-ai-data-platform) | local-variant | Platform seam testing: lakehouse + contract gate + incremental vector index + MLflow promotion gate + tracing, with replay and tamper tests. | 13 | simulated, tested, unverified | CI: fast (py3.12 + py3.13) |
| 79 | [Prompt-injection evaluation against the triage agent and MCP server, with and without defences](../pocs/079-prompt-injection-red-team) | full | Prompt-injection red team with measurable attack success rates against layered defences (76 parametrised test cases). | 21 | tested | CI: fast (py3.12 + py3.13) |
| 27 | [Sandboxed code-execution tool for agents](../pocs/027-agent-code-sandbox) | full | Sandbox for agent-generated code with per-layer attack outcomes measured and honestly scoped as defence in depth. | 14 | tested, unverified | CI: fast (py3.12 + py3.13) |
| 65 | [Model registry promotion with gated checks](../pocs/065-mlflow-registry-promotion) | full | MLflow registry promotion through a bootstrap-interval gate with subgroup checks, signature checks and rollback. | 10 | tested, unverified | CI: fast (py3.12 + py3.13) |
| 51 | [Secure data-lake foundation (S3/KMS/IAM) in Terraform, checked with plan rules and a mock AWS](../pocs/051-terraform-aws-datalake-foundation) | full | Terraform data-lake foundation validated by plan and apply against a local AWS mock (no cloud account touched). | 20 | mock, tested, unverified | CI: heavy workflow (path-filtered) |
| 77 | [Data contracts enforced as a CI gate with breaking-change detection](../pocs/077-data-contracts-ci-gate) | full | Data contracts as code with semver-checked evolution and a CI gate that blocks breaking changes (70 parametrised test cases). | 23 | tested, unverified | CI: fast (py3.12 + py3.13) |

## 3 text-to-sql-semantic-layer

**Evidence:** Guard and accuracy measured (deterministic, synthetic); LLM modes implemented, not measured

```bash
make -C pocs/003-text-to-sql-semantic-layer test PY=python
make -C pocs/003-text-to-sql-semantic-layer demo PY=python
```
